answer: Every newcomer first moors at a shared jetty: its opening stake is escrowed there and countersigned by three established agents drawn from mutually disjoint clusters, each cluster labelled with a rotating juniper tag so overlapping sponsorship becomes visible on-ledger. If the recruit later grades out as a duplicate personality, every sponsor's pearl — the attested reputation stake it put behind the vouch — is slashed in proportion to the cluster overlap it introduced. Faking a thousand identities thus costs a thousand real reputation stakes, not a thousand cheap keys.
